title: Front End Developer (SvelteKit, TypeScript)
description:
Front End Developer (SvelteKit, TypeScript) Location : On-Site 
 Job Type : Full-Time 
 Experience : No prior experience required, but personal projects, internships, or open-source contributions will be a plus. Tech Inject is a cutting-edge IT solutions provider specializing in Web Apps, hybrid mobile applications (Flutter, React Native), ERP, and E-commerce solutions. With over a decade of experience and 50+ successful projects, we engineer high-performance, visually appealing products across various industries, including travel, healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, and F&B. 
At Tech Inject, #WeEngineerImagination . Our work environment includes: Work-from-home flexibility Structured training programs Growth opportunities Responsibilities 
 What You Will Start With: Developing scalable and visually appealing user interfaces using SvelteKit, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with guidance. Collaborating with UI/UX designers and product teams to understand wireframes and implement pixel-perfect designs. Learning to implement responsive layouts, animations (GSAP, Lottie, PushIn.js), and UI performance optimizations. Ensuring cross-browser compatibility, SEO optimization, and accessibility (WCAG compliance) under mentorship. Working with SvelteKits SSR, CSR, and SSG concepts for rendering strategies. Fetching and handling API data using RESTful APIs, with gradual exposure to GraphQL APIs. Debugging UI issues and improving front-end performance based on feedback. Using Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Writing basic unit tests for front-end components to ensure stability. Understanding state management with Svelte stores for handling UI interactions. What Will Be Expected After Training: Independently building high-performance and scalable web applications with SvelteKit and TypeScript. Optimizing front-end rendering strategies using SSR, CSR, and SSG in SvelteKit. Designing and implementing complex UI interactions with state management techniques. Ensuring cross-browser compatibility, accessibility (WCAG compliance), and SEO best practices. Integrating APIs using REST and GraphQL. Writing and maintaining unit and integration tests to ensure reliability. Debugging UI issues independently and implementing performance optimizations. Engaging in code reviews, discussions on front-end architecture, and best practices. Requirements 
 What You Should Already Know: Basic proficiency in JavaScript & TypeScript Understanding of HTML, CSS, and modern CSS frameworks (Tailwind, SCSS, PostCSS) Familiarity with responsive design principles Basic knowledge of web performance optimization and accessibility concepts Understanding of Git and version control Problem-solving mindset and eagerness to learn What You Will Learn on the Job: Advanced SvelteKit and TypeScript best practices Frontend performance optimization techniques SSR, CSR, and SSG implementations in SvelteKit Integration of REST and GraphQL APIs Web accessibility (WCAG compliance) and SEO optimization State management using Svelte stores UI animations using GSAP, Lottie, and PushIn.js Unit testing and CI/CD for front-end applications Component-driven development and microfrontend architectures What We Offer: Structured training & mentorship Hands-on experience in production-level projects Career growth opportunities in front-end development Competitive salary Flexible working hours Schedule: Day shift, fixed schedule Location Type: In-person (Phagwara | Chandigarh, Punjab) relocation or reliable commute required.

Key Skills: css,javascript,html,typescript,sass,rest,frontend development,github
